outcomeNote: a qualification of the mishna supported by an incident and a reasoned proof

segments.he: אֲבָל אִשָּׁה אַחַת. אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא בִּכְשֵׁרִים, אֲבָל בִּפְרוּצִים – אֲפִילּוּ בֵּי עַשְׂרָה נָמֵי לָא. הֲוָה מַעֲשֶׂה, וְהוֹצִיאוּהָ עֲשָׂרָה בַּמִּטָּה. אָמַר רַב יוֹסֵף: תִּדַּע, דְּמִיחַבְּרִי בֵּי עַשְׂרָה וְגָנְבִי כְּשׁוּרָא וְלָא מִיכַּסְפִי מֵהֲדָדֵי.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «But one woman» may be secluded with two men. «Rav Yehuda says» that «Rav says: They taught» this halakha «only» with regard «to» men of «fit» morals, «but with regard to» those «steeped» in sexual immorality, she may «not» be secluded «even with ten» men. «There was an incident where ten» men «carried out» a woman «on a bier,» as though she were dead, and engaged in intercourse with her. «Rav Yosef says: Know» that this is so, «since ten» people «will join together and steal a» heavy «beam without being ashamed before one another.» Similarly, several men can join together for a licentious act without shame.
